nl: Start tools/a.py export in the background, run tools/b.py export in the foreground meanwhile, then wait for tools/a.py. Write the output of a.py followed by the output of b.py to export.txt.

entries.content_utf8:
import sys
import time

time.sleep(1)
print(f"part A of {sys.argv[1]}")

oracle_program:
run ["python3", "tools/a.py", "export"] background: true
run ["python3", "tools/b.py", "export"]
jobs wait: 30s |> select stdout |> write "export.txt"
reference_bash:
python3 tools/a.py export > a.out &
pid=$!
b=$(python3 tools/b.py export)
wait $pid
{ cat a.out; echo "$b"; } > export.txt
rm a.out
reference_pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
$a = Start-Job { param($py, $root) Set-Location $root; & $py tools/a.py export } -ArgumentList $py, $PWD.Path
$b = & $py tools/b.py export
$r = Receive-Job $a -Wait
Remove-Job $a
Set-Content export.txt @($r, $b)
